variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username required to sign in to the portfolio admin area.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password required to sign in to the portfolio admin area. Set this to a strong private value before deploying.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret used to sign admin session cookies. Generate a long random value and keep it private.

variables.name: BLOG_DIR
variables.description: Directory containing the Markdown blog posts, relative to the application working directory unless an absolute path is provided.
